"""Phase 0 Step 3-4: Score existing synthetic samples + correlation analysis."""
import os
os.environ["HF_HUB_OFFLINE"] = "1"
os.environ["TRANSFORMERS_OFFLINE"] = "1"
os.environ["HF_HOME"] = "/root/autodl-tmp/.hf_cache"

import json, sys, time, random
import numpy as np
from scipy import stats
import matplotlib
matplotlib.use('Agg')
import matplotlib.pyplot as plt
import torch
from torch.nn import functional as F
from pathlib import Path

sys.path.insert(0, "/root/autodl-tmp/pgpf")

from pgpf.utils import load_jsonl, save_jsonl, save_json, logger
from pgpf.data_prep import extract_assistant_texts, load_dataset_splits

OUTPUT_DIR = Path("/root/autodl-tmp/pgpf/outputs/phase0")
SYNTHETIC_PATH = OUTPUT_DIR / "synthetic.jsonl"
CHECKPOINT_PATH = OUTPUT_DIR / "checkpoint"
DATA_DIR = "/root/autodl-tmp/pgpf/data"
MODEL_NAME = "Qwen/Qwen2.5-1.5B"
STELLA_PATH = "/root/autodl-tmp/.hf_cache/models--dunzhang--stella_en_1.5B_v5/snapshots/7817065102fd9e1b031fe874e910c01f40b2f001"

def main():
    logger.info("=== Phase 0 Step 3-4: Score + Analyze ===")

    # Load data
    logger.info("Loading synthetic samples...")
    synthetic = load_jsonl(SYNTHETIC_PATH)
    logger.info(f"Loaded {len(synthetic)} synthetic samples")

    data_splits = load_dataset_splits(DATA_DIR)
    train_data = data_splits["train"]
    gen0_texts = extract_assistant_texts(train_data)
    synthetic_texts = extract_assistant_texts(synthetic)
    logger.info(f"Gen-0 corpus: {len(gen0_texts)} texts, Synthetic: {len(synthetic_texts)} texts")

    # Load models
    from transformers import AutoModelForCausalLM, AutoTokenizer
    from peft import PeftModel

    logger.info("Loading base model on cuda:1...")
    base_tokenizer = AutoTokenizer.from_pretrained(MODEL_NAME, trust_remote_code=True)
    if base_tokenizer.pad_token is None:
        base_tokenizer.pad_token = base_tokenizer.eos_token
    base_model = AutoModelForCausalLM.from_pretrained(
        MODEL_NAME, torch_dtype=torch.bfloat16, device_map={"": "cuda:1"}, trust_remote_code=True
    )
    base_model.eval()

    logger.info("Loading fine-tuned model on cuda:0...")
    ft_base = AutoModelForCausalLM.from_pretrained(
        MODEL_NAME, torch_dtype=torch.bfloat16, device_map={"": "cuda:0"}, trust_remote_code=True
    )
    ft_tokenizer = AutoTokenizer.from_pretrained(MODEL_NAME, trust_remote_code=True)
    if ft_tokenizer.pad_token is None:
        ft_tokenizer.pad_token = ft_tokenizer.eos_token
    ft_model = PeftModel.from_pretrained(ft_base, str(CHECKPOINT_PATH))
    ft_model.eval()

    # Load stella embedding model
    logger.info(f"Loading stella from: {STELLA_PATH}")
    from sentence_transformers import SentenceTransformer
    embed_model = SentenceTransformer(STELLA_PATH, device="cuda:1")

    # Compute embeddings
    logger.info("Computing gen-0 corpus embeddings...")
    gen0_embeddings = embed_model.encode(gen0_texts[:2000], batch_size=64, show_progress_bar=True, convert_to_numpy=True)
    corpus_centroid = gen0_embeddings.mean(axis=0)

    logger.info("Computing synthetic embeddings...")
    synth_embeddings = embed_model.encode(synthetic_texts, batch_size=64, show_progress_bar=True, convert_to_numpy=True)

    n = len(synthetic_texts)

    # Semantic novelty
    logger.info("[Scoring] Semantic novelty...")
    sn_scores = []
    for i in range(n):
        cos_sim = np.dot(synth_embeddings[i], corpus_centroid) / (
            np.linalg.norm(synth_embeddings[i]) * np.linalg.norm(corpus_centroid) + 1e-8
        )
        sn_scores.append(float(1.0 - cos_sim))

    # Lexical conformity
    import sacrebleu
    logger.info("[Scoring] Lexical conformity (BLEU-4 vs 50 refs)...")
    lc_scores = []
    for i, s in enumerate(synthetic_texts):
        refs = random.sample(gen0_texts, min(50, len(gen0_texts)))
        bleu_vals = [sacrebleu.sentence_bleu(s, [r]).score / 100.0 for r in refs]
        lc_scores.append(float(np.mean(bleu_vals)))
        if (i + 1) % 500 == 0:
            logger.info(f"  LC scored {i+1}/{n}")

    # Quality (base model PPL)
    logger.info("[Scoring] Quality (base model PPL)...")
    q_scores = []
    for i, s in enumerate(synthetic_texts):
        with torch.no_grad():
            enc = base_tokenizer(s, return_tensors="pt", truncation=True, max_length=2048)
            ids = enc.input_ids.to("cuda:1")
            out = base_model(ids, labels=ids)
            q_scores.append(float(torch.exp(out.loss).item()))
        if (i + 1) % 500 == 0:
            logger.info(f"  Quality scored {i+1}/{n}")

    # Confidence (ft model avg log-prob)
    logger.info("[Scoring] Confidence (ft model avg log-prob)...")
    c_scores = []
    for i, s in enumerate(synthetic_texts):
        with torch.no_grad():
            enc = ft_tokenizer(s, return_tensors="pt", truncation=True, max_length=2048)
            ids = enc.input_ids.to("cuda:0")
            out = ft_model(ids)
            logits = out.logits[:, :-1, :]
            targets = ids[:, 1:]
            log_probs = F.log_softmax(logits, dim=-1)
            token_lp = log_probs.gather(2, targets.unsqueeze(-1)).squeeze(-1)
            c_scores.append(float(token_lp.mean().item()))
        if (i + 1) % 500 == 0:
            logger.info(f"  Confidence scored {i+1}/{n}")

    # Save scored samples
    scored_data = []
    for i in range(n):
        scored_data.append({
            **synthetic[i],
            "scores": {
                "lexical_conformity": lc_scores[i],
                "semantic_novelty": sn_scores[i],
                "quality": q_scores[i],
                "confidence": c_scores[i],
            }
        })
    save_jsonl(scored_data, OUTPUT_DIR / "scored_samples.jsonl")
    logger.info(f"Saved {n} scored samples")

    # Step 4: Correlation analysis
    logger.info("=== Step 4: Correlation Analysis ===")
    properties = ["lexical_conformity", "semantic_novelty", "quality", "confidence"]
    arrays = {
        "lexical_conformity": np.array(lc_scores),
        "semantic_novelty": np.array(sn_scores),
        "quality": np.array(q_scores),
        "confidence": np.array(c_scores),
    }

    correlation_matrix = {"pearson": {}, "spearman": {}}
    for i, p1 in enumerate(properties):
        for j, p2 in enumerate(properties):
            if i < j:
                key = f"{p1}_vs_{p2}"
                pr, pp = stats.pearsonr(arrays[p1], arrays[p2])
                sr, sp = stats.spearmanr(arrays[p1], arrays[p2])
                correlation_matrix["pearson"][key] = {"r": round(float(pr), 4), "p_value": round(float(pp), 6)}
                correlation_matrix["spearman"][key] = {"rho": round(float(sr), 4), "p_value": round(float(sp), 6)}
                logger.info(f"  {key}: Pearson r={pr:.4f} (p={pp:.2e}), Spearman rho={sr:.4f} (p={sp:.2e})")

    pass_no_pair_above_07 = all(abs(v["r"]) < 0.7 for v in correlation_matrix["pearson"].values())
    lc_conf_key = "lexical_conformity_vs_confidence"
    lc_conf_r = abs(correlation_matrix["pearson"][lc_conf_key]["r"])
    pass_lc_conf_below_05 = lc_conf_r < 0.5
    overall_pass = pass_no_pair_above_07 and pass_lc_conf_below_05

    correlation_matrix["judgment"] = {
        "pass_no_pair_above_0.7": pass_no_pair_above_07,
        "pass_lc_confidence_below_0.5": pass_lc_conf_below_05,
        "overall": "PASS" if overall_pass else "FAIL",
    }

    save_json(correlation_matrix, OUTPUT_DIR / "correlation_matrix.json")
    logger.info(f"{'='*50}")
    logger.info(f"PHASE 0 RESULT: {'PASS' if overall_pass else 'FAIL'}")
    logger.info(f"  No pair |r| > 0.7: {pass_no_pair_above_07}")
    logger.info(f"  LC vs Confidence |r| < 0.5: {pass_lc_conf_below_05} (|r|={lc_conf_r:.4f})")
    logger.info(f"{'='*50}")

    # Visualization
    logger.info("Generating plots...")
    n_props = len(properties)
    corr_mat = np.eye(n_props)
    for i, p1 in enumerate(properties):
        for j, p2 in enumerate(properties):
            if i < j:
                key = f"{p1}_vs_{p2}"
                r = correlation_matrix["pearson"][key]["r"]
                corr_mat[i, j] = r
                corr_mat[j, i] = r

    fig, ax = plt.subplots(figsize=(8, 6))
    im = ax.imshow(corr_mat, cmap="RdBu_r", vmin=-1, vmax=1)
    short_names = ["LC", "SN", "Quality", "Confidence"]
    ax.set_xticks(range(n_props))
    ax.set_yticks(range(n_props))
    ax.set_xticklabels(short_names, fontsize=12)
    ax.set_yticklabels(short_names, fontsize=12)
    for i in range(n_props):
        for j in range(n_props):
            ax.text(j, i, f"{corr_mat[i,j]:.3f}", ha="center", va="center", fontsize=11,
                    color="white" if abs(corr_mat[i,j]) > 0.5 else "black")
    plt.colorbar(im, ax=ax, label="Pearson r")
    ax.set_title("Property Correlation Matrix (Phase 0)", fontsize=14)
    plt.tight_layout()
    plt.savefig(OUTPUT_DIR / "correlation_heatmap.png", dpi=150)
    plt.close()

    fig, axes = plt.subplots(2, 3, figsize=(15, 10))
    pair_idx = 0
    for i, p1 in enumerate(properties):
        for j, p2 in enumerate(properties):
            if i < j:
                ax = axes[pair_idx // 3, pair_idx % 3]
                ax.scatter(arrays[p1][:1000], arrays[p2][:1000], alpha=0.3, s=8)
                key = f"{p1}_vs_{p2}"
                r = correlation_matrix["pearson"][key]["r"]
                ax.set_xlabel(short_names[i], fontsize=10)
                ax.set_ylabel(short_names[j], fontsize=10)
                ax.set_title(f"r={r:.3f}", fontsize=11)
                pair_idx += 1
    plt.suptitle("Pairwise Property Scatter Plots (Phase 0)", fontsize=14)
    plt.tight_layout()
    plt.savefig(OUTPUT_DIR / "scatter_plots.png", dpi=150)
    plt.close()

    summary = {
        "n_samples": n,
        "property_stats": {},
        "correlation_matrix": correlation_matrix,
        "overall_result": "PASS" if overall_pass else "FAIL",
    }
    for p in properties:
        arr = arrays[p]
        summary["property_stats"][p] = {
            "mean": round(float(arr.mean()), 4),
            "std": round(float(arr.std()), 4),
            "min": round(float(arr.min()), 4),
            "max": round(float(arr.max()), 4),
        }
    save_json(summary, OUTPUT_DIR / "summary.json")
    logger.info("Phase 0 complete. All outputs saved.")

if __name__ == "__main__":
    main()
